verdict.rationale: The evidence describes provider-set retention, not user control: unlimited cloud storage for scans and fixed holding periods for physical mail (30 days for letters, 10 days for packages). It also mentions that 'secure shredding is included', but it never says users can delete their digitized mail, set retention periods, or decide when shredding happens. These are adjacent policies rather than user-controlled retention and deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
